# Matthew Kuch

I am a management consultant working in global health, and a writer. For more
than a decade I have worked on how health systems are financed and how they
deliver, at [Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance](https://www.gavi.org) in Geneva, the
[Clinton Health Access Initiative](https://www.clintonhealthaccess.org) in
Uganda and Lesotho, and Deloitte Consulting before that.

I write about where money, politics and public health meet, and I use data and
visual storytelling to make those arguments land. Most of what I publish starts
as a question I could not answer from a spreadsheet.

::: {.mk-topics}
- Health Financing

- Data Visualization
- Supply Chain Management
